subject: Request: Publish short FinLytics customer voice on AWS Marketplace listing
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alexandra Ruiz <aruiz@finlytics.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Publish short FinLytics customer voice on AWS Marketplace listing

Hi Alexandra,

Thanks again for the great convo last week — excited about how FinLytics is using our Dedicated offering to handle high-throughput scoring in production. We're preparing the AWS Marketplace listing content for the co-sell-enabled profile and we'd love to include a very short "customer voice" (one sentence, ~20-30 words) and your company logo.

Would FinLytics be comfortable with a short excerpt like the draft below? If so, could you route to whoever handles marketing/legal for a quick sign-off! Our ask:
- One short sentence that we can display on the AWS listing (we'll shorten if needed), and
- Permission to host the FinLytics logo (PNG) on the Marketplace asset page.

Draft suggestion (feel free to edit): "Redwood Inference helped FinLytics cut inference latency by 3x while reducing per-token cost, enabling faster fraud detection at scale."

If legal prefers a formal permission form, I'm happy to put that over DocuSign — timeline is next Tuesday 5/11 if possible to make the marketplace content schedule.

Thanks,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: draft_aws_listing_copy.txt (text/plain)]

From: Alexandra Ruiz <aruiz@finlytics.io>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: FinLytics Legal <legal@finlytics.io>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Publish short FinLytics customer voice on AWS Marketplace listing

Hi Sean — thanks for the clear note and the draft. We like the tone, and the statistic is accurate based on our benchmarks. I looped in legal (see cc) to confirm any required wording. A couple of small asks from our side:

- Can you shorten to one clause without company-internal detail? We prefer: "Redwood Inference reduced inference latency and cost for FinLytics' real-time scoring pipelines."
- Please provide the permission form you mentioned (legal prefers a simple one-page authorization).

I can also provide the high-res logo once legal signs off. Timing: we can aim for approval by EOD 5/12 if we have the form today.

Thanks,
Alexandra Ruiz
VP Product, FinLytics

Hi Sean and Alexandra,

Thanks for the ping. We reviewed the draft language and the proposed use. Two quick items:

1) Please use the shorter phrasing Alexandra provided.
2) We need a simple permission form that:
   - Identifies Redwood Inference as the requesting party,
   - States exact text to be used,
   - Grants permission to display the FinLytics logo in the AWS Marketplace asset, and
   - Includes a point of contact and signature line.

If you can provide the form today we'll scan and return a signed PDF. Also, please confirm you will not publish any FinLytics PII or screenshots of internal dashboards.

Regards,
FinLytics Legal (on behalf of FinLytics)
